data.one_liner: Transpiles .dag files containing text and embedded Dart code into plain .dart source files.
data.what_it_does: Transpiles .dag files—which mix literal output text with embedded Dart code PHP-style—into plain .dart source code. It features whitespace control, parameter definitions, hoisting of imports, and supports compilation via a CLI tool or package:build.
use_when: You want to generate text, HTML, or code using PHP-style template files where the file compiles directly to Dart code.
You want compile-time transpilation of text-with-code files rather than runtime template interpretation.
avoid_when: You need a standard runtime template engine.
Your project cannot use code generation or the provided CLI tools.
strengths: Compiles directly to real Dart code with zero runtime interpretation overhead.
Supports both a CLI tool and a package:build Builder via build_runner.
Provides helpful DagError traceback reporting exact .dag file line numbers.
weaknesses: A literal '?>' inside a tag's Dart code will close the tag early.
Requires a build pipeline or CLI step during development.
data.setup_notes: Add the package via pub add dag and either use the CLI tool or integrate with build_runner.
